summary: Follow feeds, search saved articles and read offline with images.
release_notes: Read saved articles and images offline, search article text, preview direct feeds and OPML imports, browse starter feeds, and track unread articles and refresh history. Failed saves can be retried without losing the previous saved copy.
user: Somebody who follows feeds and wants to read them properly.
job: Follow feeds, search saved articles and read offline with images.
offline: Saved articles read without the network, images included; refreshing needs it.

data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; OPML import brings it back from your computer

data.kind: the articles saved for offline reading
data.location: the app's shelf storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; refreshing fetches them again

capabilities_required.name: network
capabilities_required.purpose: to refresh your feeds and fetch their articles

non_goals: It does not sync with a feed service.
It does not fetch what a feed does not publish.
